verdict: PASS (5/5): ESD's parent action embeds a Starobinsky-plateau inflation attractor (Master Ch.15) yielding the single-field slow-roll predictions r = 12/N_e^2 ~ 3.3e-3 and n_s = 1 - 2/N_e ~ 0.967 at N_e = 60 (standard reheating window). The r prediction sits a factor ~11 below the current best 95% CL upper limit (BICEP/Keck BK18, r < 0.036) and ~32 below ACT DR4 + WMAP. The n_s prediction matches Planck 2018 (0.9649 +/- 0.0042) at 0.12 sigma. Forward falsifiability: LiteBIRD (sigma_r ~ 1e-3) reaches ~3 sigma at the ESD-predicted r; CMB-S4 (sigma_r ~ 5e-4) reaches 6.6 sigma; PICO concept reaches ~33 sigma. A future r < 1e-3 (5 sigma) at N_e in the 50-70 range falsifies the plateau anchor; r > 0.01 would also point to a different parent-action embedding. No new free parameters are introduced beyond the standard reheating e-fold window.
